feed.title: iSNARE
feed.subtitle: iSNARE — Improving SNAREopathy Perspectives. An international consortium developing and validating novel therapies and predictive biomarkers for SNAREopathies, rare neurodevelopmental disorders caused by mutations in SNARE-pathway genes.

entry.title: Welcome to the iSNARE blog
entry.content:
The blog carries longer updates from the consortium: summaries of results, protocols worth sharing, and notes from the annual patient family meeting.

Posts are markdown files in the _posts/ folder, named YYYY-MM-DD-title.md.
entry.summary: What the iSNARE consortium is working on and where to find our results.
